name: POST /api/webhooks/endpoints/:endpoint_id/subscribe - Subscribe to event_type
description: Subscribes a registered endpoint to one event_type, with an optional filter_predicate. The endpoint_id is taken from the PATH and overwrites any endpoint_id present in the body. The event_type is resolved BASELINE-FIRST THEN TENANT-SCOPED (TK-4145): the platform EVENT_TYPE_REGISTRY is checked first, then the types registered by the OWNING ENDPOINT's tenant via POST /api/events/types — so a vertical can subscribe to its own registered events, while another tenant's types remain unresolvable here. Edge cases: :endpoint_id must be a UUID and event_type must be non-empty; a type in neither the baseline nor that tenant's registrations returns 400 UnregisteredEventType, a distinct code from the plain ValidationError, and the message names POST /api/events/types rather than a constant the caller cannot reach; ERROR PRECEDENCE — the endpoint is looked up BEFORE the event type is resolved (its tenant is what the type resolves against), so a bad endpoint_id plus an unknown event_type returns 404 EndpointNotFound, not 400; filter_predicate is accepted only if it is an object and is otherwise silently dropped rather than rejected; re-subscribing the same (endpoint, event_type) is an upsert (ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE) that reactivates the row and replaces the filter, so it is idempotent rather than a duplicate-key error.

errorCases.when: Authorization header absent or not in 'Bearer <jwt>' form (requireAuth preHandler)
JWT signature invalid, malformed, or exp has elapsed

errorCases.message: endpoint_id must be a UUID / event_type is required
errorCases.when: validateSubscribe fails; all failures are returned together in details[]

errorCases.message: event_type '<event_type>' is not registered for this endpoint's tenant. Register it with POST /api/events/types, then subscribe.
errorCases.when: the event_type is in neither the platform EVENT_TYPE_REGISTRY baseline nor the owning endpoint tenant's registered types (audit.tenant_event_type)

:endpoint_id is a valid UUID but no webhook endpoint row matches. Takes PRECEDENCE over UnregisteredEventType — the endpoint is resolved first because its tenant is the scope the event type is resolved against.
Unexpected service/DB failure (connection loss, or a constraint the handler does not map)
